text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-87654321 fired for r-inference-us-west-2.az3 — high KV cache eviction rate and continuous node-level OOMs. Severity: P1. Auto-created incident channel: #incidents. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-87654321 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: PD-87654321: Triggered by alert 'kv-cache-eviction-rate > 20% for 5m' — primary paging rule (prod). Notified: Alex G, Priya R, oncall-sre.

Alex G: I got the page, acking. I'm pulling metrics and logs now. jumping into az3 hosts.

Jin L: Seeing eviction_rate 34% on az3-kvc-*. GPU mem shows frequent GC, host mem creep before oom:
```
eviction_rate: 34.2%
error_rate_5m: 2.1%
request_latency_p95: 820ms
gpu_mem_util: 93%
host_free_mem_mb: 200 -> 60 over 10m
```
Looks like KV cache growth + spot reclaiming causing pod restarts.

Priya R: If AZ3 keeps evicting KV pages we should activate routing fallback to az1/az2. Alex — can you confirm whether autoscaler is thrashing or if it's host-level OOMs causing eviction cascades?

Alex G: Autoscaler is stable; node-level OOMs appear correlated with a recent rollout of quantized-cache PRI build from last night. Rolling back isn't safe mid-flight for all models. I'm going to try a targeted pod restart and bump KV eviction thresholds as a mitigation.

Sara M: Customer impact check: preliminary numbers — ~9% of requests in us-west-2 saw latency >1s, ~1.6% 5xxs. A mix of hosted API and a few dedicated tenants in us-west-2. No SLA breaches reported yet, but errors spiking for some routes.

Mike C: Initiating canary reroute now. Console command: `rdw route update --region us-west-2 --fallback az1,az2 --canary 30`

Alex G: Running mitigation commands now:
```
# increase kvcache soft limit on problematic pools
rdw infra kvcache set --pool az3-kvc --soft-limit 0.75
# targeted restart of pods matching cache-quantized label
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/cache-quantized --selector=az=az3
```

incident-bot: Action logged: user Alex G executed two mitigation actions.

pagerduty: PD-87654321: Acknowledged by Alex G. Escalation timer paused.

oncall-sre: Escalating to Priya R for region-level decisions (routing/failover).

Priya R: I'm taking lead. Starting progressive failover: shift 30% traffic off az3 to az1/az2, monitor error and latency. If errors don't drop within 5m, move to 60%.

Mike C: Failover in progress — current routing: az3 70% -> az1/az2 30%. Dedicated capacity reserved in az1 to handle burst. Observability link: https://console.redwood/ops/streams/PD-87654321

Jin L: After pod restarts and soft-limit bump, eviction_rate dropped to 12% in az3, GPU mem stabilized to 80-85%. p95 latency dropped to 640ms. Still seeing some tail errors from a subset of quantized models.

Sara M: Notifying customer success for top-impacted tenants and opening targeted customer tickets. Suggested notif copy drafted: "We observed increased latency in us-west-2; we are routing traffic and mitigating — we'll follow up with a timeline and RCA." Approve? :+1:

Alex G: Approve. Also saving heap profile and cache traces for postmortem: `rdw diag export --target az3-kvc --since 30m --out /tmp/pd8765-traces.tar.gz`

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-87654321: Status update recorded — mitigations applied by Alex G and routing changes by Mike C.

pagerduty: PD-87654321: Incident escalated to Senior SRE Priya R (ack required).

Priya R: Acked. I'm going to keep the failover active until we can confirm stable ops for 1 hour. Assigning postmortem owner: Priya R. Action items: collect kernel OOM logs from affected hosts, review last night's quantized-cache rollout, validate autoscaler backoff knobs, and refine KV cache soft-limit defaults.

Mike C: Current customer-visible metrics: error rate back to baseline ~0.3%, p95 latency for region ~520ms after failover. Rolling back canary to 20% on az3 while we watch.

oncall-sre: Handoff note — Alex G will continue for debugging for another 30m, then hand to oncall-sre for watch. Priya R is incident owner for postmortem.

Sara M: Drafting incident notice to affected customers now. Will wait 30m to include final mitigations and ETA for RCA.

Alex G: Leaving detailed logs in the incident channel and linking runbook entries. If anyone sees a re-spike, ping me directly.

Priya R: Incident mitigated — routing and soft-limits handled most symptoms. Keeping watch for 2h, then we can transition to monitoring-only. Postmortem timeline within 48h. Great cross-team response — thanks all. :white_check_mark:
